parts.quote: Give me an overview of this week: what's on, the open tasks and the shopping list.

answers.text: This week features Swim training for Ellie on Tuesday, October 6; Early shift for Lukas, Client meeting for Sofia, Piano lesson for Ellie, Football training for Noah, and Work dinner for Lukas on Wednesday, October 7; Dentist checkup and Swimming for Noah on Thursday, October 8; and Sunday planning on Sunday, October 11. Open tasks are buying a birthday present for Mila and booking the car service, and the shopping list includes Bread, Cheddar, Tomatoes, Pasta, and Eggs.
